// FVGs+IFVG+OTE4: the FVGs+IFVG+OTE5 indicator without the breakers, mitigation blocks and Delivery
// Engine (see ICTblocks; its IFVG confirmation and inversion rules are kept here) and without the
// swing-mode IFVGs (IFVGs are created on a close through the FVG).
// The rest (FVGs, 1PFVGs, wick C.E., filters, IFVGs, OTE, poor liquidity) is the same.

//@version=6
indicator("FVGs+IFVG+OTE4", 
    overlay=true, 
    max_lines_count    = 500,
    max_boxes_count    = 500,
    max_bars_back      = 5000)


getstyle(s) =>
    switch s
        "solid" => line.style_solid
        "dashed" => line.style_dashed
        "dotted" => line.style_dotted

getsize(s) =>
    switch(s) 
        "auto" => size.auto
        "tiny" => size.tiny
        "small" => size.small
        "normal" => size.normal
        "large" => size.large
        "huge" => size.huge


gethalign(s) =>
    switch s
        "left" => text.align_left
        "right" => text.align_right
        => text.align_center

getvalign(s) =>
    switch s
        "top" => text.align_top
        "bottom" => text.align_bottom
        => text.align_center

    tooltip = "Which FVGs are drawn (1PFVGs and the close-mode IFVG logic are not filtered).\n"+
        "A sweep is a bar breaking the last confirmed short-term high / low.\n"+
        "sweeps: the last FVG before the sweep and the first one after it.\n"+
        "sweeps&mid: also the largest FVG near the middle of the arm (last opposite pivot -> sweep).\n"+
        "relevant: the first FVG after a sweep; the last one before it only once it becomes an IFVG (a close "+
        "through it); FVGs flagged OTE (needs 'Flag OTE FVGs'); and, on the last bar, the live FVGs within "+
        "min swing (ATR) x ATR of the price. FVGs too small for a C.E. are drawn lighter and without border, and "+
        "are hidden once filled unless they formed at a swing high / low (Swing pivot left / right) or were "+
        "extended by a merged FVG. relevant is the slowest filter: every bar it checks all hidden live FVGs.\n"+
        "recent relevant: as relevant, but hidden FVGs older than 1000 bars are dropped (they no longer "+
        "reappear), which keeps it fast on long histories.")
bool fponly = drawMode == "1PFVGs"            // regular FVGs are discarded
bool ifvgOnly = drawMode == "IFVGs"           // all FVGs are hidden, 1PFVGs included
bool hideReg = drawMode == "IFVGs" or drawMode == "1PFVGs+IFVGs"  // regular FVGs, wicks, swing labels, signals hidden

// Poor liquidity ============================================
G_PL = "Poor liquidity"
plMode = input.string("auto", "Poor liquidity", options = ["auto", "yes", "no"], group = G_PL,
    tooltip = "For thin markets, where price often jumps between two candles. On: volume imbalances are "+
        "ignored (FVG boxes are not extended over body gaps), and two up-close (down-close) candles in a row "+
        "with a gap between them make a bullish (bearish) FVG, as if an up (down) candle was in the middle. "+
        "auto: on for nano futures only (symbol or description with Nano / NNQ).")
bool poorLiq = plMode == "yes" or (plMode == "auto" and (str.contains(str.lower(syminfo.description), "nano")
     or str.startswith(syminfo.root, "NNQ") or str.startswith(syminfo.ticker, "NNQ")))

bounces(p) =>
    (math.abs(p-low) < 2 and close > low+10) or (math.abs(p-high)<2 and close < high-10)

var debug=false
var tfsecs = timeframe.in_seconds()
// Wicks ===================================================
wdx() =>
    r = wickdx
    if r == 0 and tfsecs/60 < 15
        r := 4
    else if r == 0
        r := 1
    r
var wicks = array.new<line>()
if dowick
    bodyh = math.max(open[1],close[1])
    bodyl = math.min(open[1],close[1])
    wh = high[1]-bodyh
    wl = bodyl-low[1]
    
    if wh > minwick
        ce = math.avg(high[1],bodyh)
        ln = line.new(bar_index-1, ce, bar_index-1+wdx(), ce, style = wicksty, color = hideReg ? color.new(wickcol, 100) : wickcol)
        wicks.push(ln)
    if wl > minwick
        ce = math.avg(low[1],bodyl)
        ln = line.new(bar_index-1, ce, bar_index-1+wdx(), ce, style = wicksty, color = hideReg ? color.new(wickcol, 100) : wickcol)
        wicks.push(ln)
    if wicks.size() > nwicks
        w = wicks.shift()
        w.delete()
    if dowickalert and barstate.isconfirmed
        for w in wicks
            p = w.get_y1()
            if bounces(p)
                if debug
                    line.new(bar_index,low,bar_index,high,extend = extend.both)
                alert("bounce on wick C.E.", alert.freq_once_per_bar)

// FVGs ======================================================

if tz == "Auto"
    if str.contains(syminfo.description, "DAX") or str.contains(syminfo.ticker, "DAX") or str.contains(syminfo.description, "Germany") or str.contains(syminfo.ticker, "FDX")
        fpfvgtime := "0900"
        tz := "Europe/Madrid"
    else
        tz := "America/New_York"

hmParse(string s) =>
    hs = str.substring(s, 0, 2)
    ms = str.substring(s, 2, 4)
    [int(str.tonumber(hs)), int(str.tonumber(ms))]

var fph = 0
var fpm = 0

if dofp
    [xh, xm] = hmParse(fpfvgtime)
    fph := xh
    fpm := xm

// FVG data type, one per handled fvg.
type FVG
    float hi // max value
    float lo // min value
    float ce // C.E.
    bool islong // bullish?
    int start  // time for start
    int end = na// time when mitigated
    int updEnd = na // [PERF] end already applied to the drawings (finished FVGs are then skipped)
    int inhSeq = na // [PERF] tagSeq when ifvgInherit last scanned for this IFVG
    box rect = na // box drawn
    line celine = na // CE line
    bool isfp = false // is first presented FVG
    bool iswfp = false // is week first presented FVG
    bool isifp = false // is first presented FVG inverse
    int sbar = na // [OTE] bar index where the FVG starts
    line hiln = na // segments style: high line
    line loln = na // segments style: low line
    bool kept = false // kept confirmed IFVG (box shown as IFVG)
    int kdir = 0 // -1 bearish IFVG, 1 bullish IFVG
    FVG dup = na // older almost identical FVG that absorbed this one
    bool cand = false // current IFVG candidate (its box is shown as IFVG)
    bool own = false // the box exists only because of the IFVG (the FVG itself is not drawn)
    bool shown = false // FVG is in the drawn arrays
    bool aplus = false // [DE] A+ FVG (born from an A+ MSS)
    bool disp = false // [DE] middle candle is a displacement candle
    bool brk = false // [BRK] tagged at a breaker pullback
    int brkD = 0 // [BRK] direction of that breaker
    int mbD = 0 // [MB] direction of the mitigation block it was tagged at (1 bullish, -1 bearish), 0 none
    int lblD = 0 // direction of the B / M / BM label
    bool ote = false // [OTEF] OTE FVG
    float oLo = na // [OTEF] leg low / high: origin and extreme since the FVG
    float oHi = na
    bool swp = false // [REL] last FVG before a sweep: shown once it becomes an IFVG
    bool ext = false // [REL] extended by a merged duplicate
    int dbar = na // [REL] bar index where it was filled

// [PERF] bumped whenever an FVG gets a breaker / mitigation block tag, is widened by a merge or a tagged one is
// drawn: ifvgInherit
// only rescans the FVGs when this changed (an array, since functions cannot assign global variables)
var array<int> tagSeq = array.from(0)
bumpTags() =>
    tagSeq.set(0, tagSeq.get(0) + 1)



// label of a plain FVG box: A+, or the breaker / mitigation block tag (B↑, M↓, BM↑...), plus OTE
fvgLbl(FVG f) =>
    string t = ""
    if f.aplus and lblAp
        t := hideReg ? "" : "A+"
    else if f.brk or f.mbD != 0
        t := (f.brk and f.mbD != 0 ? "BM" : f.brk ? "B" : "M") + (f.lblD == 1 ? "↑" : "↓")
    if f.ote and not hideReg
        t += (t == "" ? "" : " ") + "OTE"
    t

// [OTEF] swings of the chart timeframe for the leg origin
var float otePL = na
var int otePLb = na
var float otePH = na
var int otePHb = na
float otePivL = ta.pivotlow(low, pivL, pivR)
float otePivH = ta.pivothigh(high, pivL, pivR)
if not na(otePivL)
    otePL := otePivL
    otePLb := bar_index - pivR
if not na(otePivH)
    otePH := otePivH
    otePHb := bar_index - pivR

// [OTEF] leg of a new FVG (candles [3] to [1]): origin = the lowest low (bullish) / highest high (bearish) from the
// last swing before the FVG, extreme = the high / low of the FVG candles
method oteInit(FVG f) =>
    if oteFvg
        int n = 3
        if f.islong and not na(otePLb) and otePLb <= bar_index - 3
            n := math.min(bar_index - otePLb, 4000)
        else if not f.islong and not na(otePHb) and otePHb <= bar_index - 3
            n := math.min(bar_index - otePHb, 4000)
        float lo = low[1]
        float hi = high[1]
        for k = 1 to n
            if f.islong
                lo := math.min(lo, low[k])
            else
                hi := math.max(hi, high[k])
        if f.islong
            f.oLo := lo
            f.oHi := math.max(high[1], high[2], high[3])
        else
            f.oHi := hi
            f.oLo := math.min(low[1], low[2], low[3])

// [OTEF] once per bar for a live FVG: true on the bar it retraces into the FVG while it matches the OTE band
method oteFvgStep(FVG f) =>
    bool hit = false
    if oteFvg and not f.ote and not na(f.oLo) and not na(f.oHi)
        float r = f.oHi - f.oLo
        if r > 0 and barstate.isconfirmed
            float bLo = f.islong ? f.oHi - oteMax * r : f.oLo + oteMin * r
            float bHi = f.islong ? f.oHi - oteMin * r : f.oLo + oteMax * r
            bool m = oteMode == "Overlap" ? f.hi >= bLo and f.lo <= bHi
                 : oteMode == "Fully inside" ? f.lo >= bLo and f.hi <= bHi
                 : f.ce >= bLo and f.ce <= bHi
            bool tap = f.islong ? low <= f.hi : high >= f.lo
            if m and tap
                f.ote := true
                hit := true
        // keep extending the leg AFTER evaluating this bar
        if f.islong
            f.oHi := math.max(f.oHi, high)
        else
            f.oLo := math.min(f.oLo, low)
    hit

method kill(FVG f) =>
    if not na(f)
        if not na(f.rect)
            f.rect.delete()
        if not na(f.celine)
            f.celine.delete()
        if not na(f.hiln)
            f.hiln.delete()
        if not na(f.loln)
            f.loln.delete()
        f.rect := na
        f.celine := na
        f.hiln := na
        f.loln := na
method alerts(FVG f) =>
    a = false
    if not na(f.hi) and bounces(f.hi)
        alert("bounce on FVG hi", alert.freq_once_per_bar)
        a := true
    else if not na(f.lo) and bounces(f.lo)
        alert("bounce on fvg lo", alert.freq_once_per_bar)
        a := true
    else if not na(f.ce) and bounces(f.ce)
        alert("bounce on CE", alert.freq_once_per_bar)
        a := true
    if a and debug
        line.new(bar_index,low,bar_index,high,extend = extend.both)
    a


// known  fvgs: long and short
var array<FVG> lfvgs = array.new<FVG>()
var array<FVG> sfvgs = array.new<FVG>()
var array<FVG> fpfvgs = array.new<FVG>()

// FVG functions =========

//[o1,c1,h1,l1,o2,c2,h2,l2,o3,c3,h3,l3,t2] = request.security(syminfo.tickerid, tf, 
//  [open[1], close[1], high[1], low[1], open[2], close[2], high[2], low[2],
//  open[3],close[3],high[3],low[3],time[2]], lookahead=barmerge.lookahead_on)


clearlastfp(array<FVG> fpfvgs) =>
    while fpfvgs.size() > nfp
        f = fpfvgs.shift()
        if not na(f) and f.isfp
            if not na(f.rect)
                f.rect.set_extend(extend.none)
            if not na(f.celine)
                f.celine.set_extend(extend.none)
            if not na(f.hiln)
                f.hiln.set_extend(extend.none)
            if not na(f.loln)
                f.loln.set_extend(extend.none)
            f.isfp := false
            f.kill()

isLongFVG(l1,h3) =>
    l1 > h3
longFVGHL(o1,c1,l1,o2,c2,o3,c3,h3) =>
    hi = l1
    lo = h3
    blow1 = math.min(o1,c1)
    bhi2 = math.max(o2,c2)
    blow2 = math.min(o2,c2)
    bhi3 = math.max(o3,c3)
    // include suspension blocks
    fhi = hi
    flo = lo
    if bhi3 < blow2 and not poorLiq
        lo := bhi3
    if blow1 > bhi2 and not poorLiq
        hi := blow1
    [hi,lo, fhi, flo]

isShortFVG(h1,l3) =>
    h1 < l3
shortFVGHL(o1,c1,h1,o2,c2,o3,c3,l3) =>
    hi = l3
    lo = h1
    blow3 = math.min(o3,c3)
    bhi2 = math.max(o2,c2)
    blow2 = math.min(o2,c2)
    bhi1 = math.max(o1,c1)
    // include suspension blocks
    fhi = hi
    flo = lo
    if blow3 > bhi2 and not poorLiq
        hi := blow3
    if bhi1 < blow2 and not poorLiq
        lo := bhi1
    [hi, lo, fhi, flo]

// 1PFVG from the 1m candles (charts above 1m and below 15m)
// (simple: also selects the timeframe of request.security_lower_tf)
bool fpLowTf = fp1m and timeframe.isminutes and timeframe.in_seconds() > 60 and timeframe.in_seconds() < 900
bool fpLow = dofp and fpLowTf

isFPFVG() =>
    r = dofp
    if r
        h = hour(time,tz)
        m = minute(time,tz)
        nmin = 2
        if timeframe.isminutes
            nmin := tfsecs/60 * 2
        r := h == fph and m > fpm+nmin and timeframe.isminutes and tfsecs/60 <=3 and not fpLow
    r
if bar_index == 0
    log.info("fpfvg h {0} fpfvgm {1}", fph, fpm)

eqFVG(a,b) =>
    a.hi == b.hi and a.lo == b.lo and a.idx == b.idx

method endsAt(FVG f) =>
    na(f.end) ? time : f.end

method isDone(FVG f, o, c) =>
    f.islong ? (c < f.lo or o < f.lo) : (c>f.hi or o > f.hi)

// [REL] "relevant" filter: a plain FVG too small to draw its C.E.
method relSmall(FVG f) =>
    fltRel and not f.isfp and not f.isifp and f.hi - f.lo <= mince

method bgColor(FVG f) =>
    c = f.islong ? lcol : scol
    if f.isfp
        c := fpcol
        if f.iswfp
            c := wfpcol
    if f.isifp
        c := ifpcol
    bool hid = hideReg and (ifvgOnly or (not f.isfp and not f.isifp))
    // [REL] too small for a C.E.: a little more transparent
    if f.relSmall()
        c := color.new(c, color.t(c) + (100 - color.t(c)) / 2)
    styNoFill ? color(na) : (hid ? color.new(c, 100) : c)
    

method lnColor(FVG f) =>
    c = f.islong ? lnlcol : lnscol
    if f.isfp
        c := lnfpcol
        if f.iswfp
            c := lnwfpcol
    if f.isifp
        c := ilnfpcol
    bool hid = hideReg and (ifvgOnly or (not f.isfp and not f.isifp))
    // [REL] too small for a C.E.: no border (boxes only; segments are the lines themselves)
    hid or (f.relSmall() and not stySeg) ? color.new(c, 100) : c

// IFVG boxes: the FVG box itself is turned into the IFVG box (no second box on the same place) ====
var array<FVG> keptIf = array.new<FVG>()   // FVGs whose box is currently shown as IFVG

// back to the plain FVG, as it was before becoming an IFVG
method restore(FVG f) =>
    f.kept := false
    f.cand := false
    if not na(f.rect)
        if f.own or stySeg
            f.rect.delete()
            f.rect := na
            f.own := false
        else
            f.rect.set_bgcolor(f.bgColor())
            f.rect.set_border_color(f.lnColor())
            f.rect.set_border_width(1)
            f.rect.set_text(fvgLbl(f))
            f.rect.set_right(f.endsAt())
            f.rect.set_extend((f.isifp or f.isfp) ? extend.right : extend.none)
    true

// the (older) FVG that absorbed a duplicate is the one that is shown
method adopt(FVG fv, int dir) =>
    FVG f = na(fv.dup) ? fv : fv.dup
    color c = dir < 0 ? bearIFVGColor : bullIFVGColor
    if na(f.rect)
        f.rect := box.new(f.start, f.hi, time, f.lo, xloc = xloc.bar_time)
        f.own := not (f.shown or f.isfp or f.isifp)
    if f.isfp or f.isifp
        // also a 1PFVG: IFVG label, but 1PFVG colors and behaviour (extends right)
        color fc = f.isifp ? ifpcol : (f.iswfp ? wfpcol : fpcol)
        color lc = f.isifp ? ilnfpcol : (f.iswfp ? lnwfpcol : lnfpcol)
        f.rect.set_bgcolor(styNoFill ? color(na) : fc)
        f.rect.set_border_color(lc)
        f.rect.set_border_width(1)
        f.rect.set_extend(extend.right)
    else
        f.rect.set_bgcolor(color.new(c, ifvgTrans))
        f.rect.set_border_color(color.new(c, borderTrans))
        f.rect.set_border_width(2)
        f.rect.set_extend(extend.none)
    f.rect.set_right(time)
    // an unconfirmed candidate keeps its B / M / BM label (confirming it sets the IFVG label)
    f.rect.set_text(f.brk or f.mbD != 0 ? fvgLbl(f) : "")
    f.rect.set_text_color(ifvgTxtCol)
    f.rect.set_text_size(ifvgtsz)
    f.rect.set_text_halign(ifvgha)
    f.rect.set_text_valign(ifvgva)
    if not f.kept
        keptIf.push(f)
    f.kept := true
    f.cand := true
    f.kdir := dir
    f.rect

// the IFVG candidate is replaced: keep it if confirmed (and wanted), else restore the FVG
method release(FVG fv, bool confirmed, int ctime) =>
    FVG f = na(fv.dup) ? fv : fv.dup
    f.cand := false
    if f.kept
        if keepIFVG and confirmed
            if na(f.end)
                f.end := ctime
            if keptIf.size() > keepMax + 3
                FVG o = keptIf.shift()
                if o.cand
                    keptIf.push(o)
                else
                    o.restore()
        else
            f.restore()
    true

// extend the IFVG boxes; restore kept ones when invalidated (close back through them)
updKept() =>
    int n = keptIf.size()
    if n > 0
        for i = n - 1 to 0
            FVG f = keptIf.get(i)
            if na(f.rect) or not f.kept
                f.kept := false
                f.cand := false
                keptIf.remove(i)
            else if not f.cand and barstate.isconfirmed and (f.kdir < 0 ? close > f.hi : close < f.lo)
                f.restore()
                keptIf.remove(i)
            else
                f.rect.set_right(time)
    true

// widen g (older FVG) with f (new almost identical one): max hi / min lo, for both, and extend g
// (a 1PFVG is never changed by a duplicate: it keeps its zone)
method mergeZone(FVG g, FVG f) =>
    if not g.kept and not g.isfp and not g.isifp
        float nh = math.max(g.hi, f.hi)
        float nl = math.min(g.lo, f.lo)
        g.hi := nh
        g.lo := nl
        g.ce := math.avg(nh, nl)
        f.hi := nh
        f.lo := nl
        f.ce := g.ce
        if not na(g.rect)
            g.rect.set_top(nh)
            g.rect.set_bottom(nl)
        if not na(g.hiln)
            g.hiln.set_y1(nh)
            g.hiln.set_y2(nh)
            g.loln.set_y1(nl)
            g.loln.set_y2(nl)
        if not na(g.celine)
            g.celine.set_y1(g.ce)
            g.celine.set_y2(g.ce)
        g.end := na
        g.ext := true
        bumpTags()
    true

// FVG filtering around liquidity sweeps ==============================================
type FltState
    int post = 1000000      // FVGs shown since the last sweep (starts high: nothing shown before the first sweep)
    float stH = na          // last confirmed short-term high (not swept yet)
    float stL = na
    int stHbar = na
    int stLbar = na

var FltState fs = FltState.new()
var array<FVG> pendF = array.new<FVG>()  // FVGs since the last sweep that are not shown (yet)
var array<FVG> relF = array.new<FVG>()   // [REL] live FVGs not shown (yet)
var array<box> relB = array.new<box>()   // [REL] boxes of the live FVGs near the price (last bar only)
var array<FVG> relS = array.new<FVG>()   // [REL] small drawn FVGs just filled, waiting for the swing check

insertSorted(array<FVG> a, FVG f) =>
    int pos = a.size()
    while pos > 0 and a.get(pos - 1).start > f.start
        pos -= 1
    f.shown := true
    a.insert(pos, f)
    if f.brkD != 0 or f.mbD != 0
        bumpTags()
    true

// older drawn FVG (any bias) that is almost exactly the same zone as f
findDup(FVG f) =>
    FVG r = na
    float tol = (f.hi - f.lo) * dupTol / 100.0
    if dupTol > 0
        // drawn FVGs, first presented ones and FVGs whose box is shown as IFVG (they may not be in the other lists)
        for k = 0 to 3
            array<FVG> arr = k == 0 ? lfvgs : (k == 1 ? sfvgs : (k == 2 ? fpfvgs : keptIf))
            int n = arr.size()
            if n > 0
                for i = n - 1 to 0
                    FVG g = arr.get(i)
                    if math.abs(g.hi - f.hi) <= tol and math.abs(g.lo - f.lo) <= tol and (na(r) or g.start > r.start)
                        r := g
                        break
    r

method route(FltState s, FVG f) =>
    FVG d = findDup(f)
    bool shown = false
    if not na(d)
        // extend the old FVG instead of adding the new one; the new FVG keeps feeding the IFVG logic.
        // A 1PFVG is never changed by a duplicate: it keeps its zone
        f.dup := d
        d.mergeZone(f)
    else if fltOff
        shown := true
    else if s.post < flN
        shown := true
        s.post += 1
    if shown
        insertSorted(f.islong ? lfvgs : sfvgs, f)
    else if na(d)
        pendF.push(f)
        if pendF.size() > 60
            pendF.shift()
        if fltRel
            relF.push(f)
            if relF.size() > 300
                relF.shift()
    true

// show a pending FVG: if a drawn one is almost the same zone, merge into it instead of drawing a second box
reveal(FVG f) =>
    FVG d = f.kept ? na : findDup(f)
    if na(d)
        insertSorted(f.islong ? lfvgs : sfvgs, f)
    else
        f.dup := d
        // a 1PFVG keeps its zone and start
        if f.start < d.start and not d.kept and not d.isfp and not d.isifp
            // the revealed FVG is the older one: the merged box starts where it started
            d.start := f.start
            if not na(d.rect)
                d.rect.set_left(d.start)
            if not na(d.hiln)
                d.hiln.set_x1(d.start)
                d.loln.set_x1(d.start)
            if not na(d.celine)
                d.celine.set_x1(d.start)
        d.mergeZone(f)
    true

// a sweep happened: reveal the last FVG before it (and, optionally, the most significant one near the middle of the arm)
onSweep(int armStart) =>
    int n = pendF.size()
    if n > 0
        FVG lastF = pendF.get(n - 1)
        // [REL] the last FVG before the sweep waits to become an IFVG
        if fltRel
            lastF.swp := true
            lastF := na
        FVG midF = na
        if fltMid and n > 1 and not na(armStart) and armStart < bar_index
            int mb = math.round((armStart + bar_index) / 2.0)
            int w = math.max(1, math.round((bar_index - armStart) * flWin / 100.0))
            float best = 0.0
            for i = 0 to n - 2
                FVG g = pendF.get(i)
                float sz = g.hi - g.lo
                if g.sbar >= mb - w and g.sbar <= mb + w and sz > best
                    best := sz
                    midF := g
        if not na(lastF)
            reveal(lastF)
        if not na(midF)
            reveal(midF)
        pendF.clear()
    true

bool deDispOK = false
// IFVG label: sign, inversion count, OTE (and its timeframes), A+
ifvgTxt(int d, int inv, bool ote, string tags, bool ap, int mbd) =>
    string t = "IFVG" + (lblSign ? (d < 0 ? "-" : "+") : "")
    if inv > 1
        t += " ×" + str.tostring(inv)
    if ote
        t += " OTE" + (lblTf and tags != "" ? " " + tags : "")
    if ap and lblAp
        t += " A+"
    if mbd != 0 and mbd == d
        t += mbd > 0 ? " ↑" : " ↓"
    t

// [MB] arrow direction of an IFVG's FVG
mbOf(FVG f) =>
    na(f) ? 0 : f.mbD

// confirmation of a close (or full body) through an FVG
upBreak(float hi) =>
    deConf == "Full body" ? math.min(open, close) > hi : close > hi
dnBreak(float lo) =>
    deConf == "Full body" ? math.max(open, close) < lo : close < lo

var hasfp = false
var hasifp = false
if hour(time,tz) != fph
    hasfp := false
    hasifp := false
timeat(int n) =>
    time[-n]
FVG lastlongfvg = na
FVG lastshortfvg = na
if true
    [hi, lo, fhi, flo] = longFVGHL(open[1], close[1], low[1], open[2],
         close[2], open[3], close[3], high[3])
    // [PL] poor liquidity: two up-close candles in a row with a gap make an FVG (as if one more was between)
    int fk = 3
    if poorLiq and not (fhi - flo > minfvg) and close[1] > open[1] and close[2] > open[2] and low[1] > high[2]
        hi := low[1]
        lo := high[2]
        fhi := hi
        flo := lo
        fk := 2
    if fhi - flo > minfvg and fhi-flo < maxfvg and (not deDisp or deDispOK or isFPFVG() or (not hasifp and hasfp and doifp and not fpLow))
        f = FVG.new(hi,lo,math.avg(hi,lo),true,timeat(-fk))
        f.sbar := bar_index - fk // [OTE]
        f.oteInit() // [OTEF]
        f.aplus := false // [DE] A+ off
        f.disp := deDispOK // [DE]
        lastlongfvg := f
        if not hasifp and hasfp and doifp and not fpLow
            fp = fpfvgs.last()
            if fp.islong != f.islong
                f.isifp := true
                hasifp := true
                fpfvgs.push(f)
        if not hasfp and isFPFVG() and not f.isifp
            f.isfp := true
            f.iswfp := dayofweek == dayofweek.monday
            hasfp := f.isfp
            fpfvgs.push(f)
            clearlastfp(fpfvgs)
        else if not fponly and not f.isifp and (not deDisp or deDispOK)
            fs.route(f)
        else
            f.kill()
if true
    [hi, lo, fhi, flo] = shortFVGHL(open[1], close[1], high[1], open[2],
         close[2], open[3], close[3], low[3])
    // [PL] poor liquidity: two down-close candles in a row with a gap make an FVG (as if one more was between)
    int fk = 3
    if poorLiq and not (fhi - flo > minfvg) and close[1] < open[1] and close[2] < open[2] and high[1] < low[2]
        hi := low[2]
        lo := high[1]
        fhi := hi
        flo := lo
        fk := 2
    if fhi - flo > minfvg and fhi - flo < maxfvg and (not deDisp or deDispOK or isFPFVG() or (not hasifp and hasfp and doifp and not fpLow))
        f = FVG.new(hi,lo,math.avg(hi,lo),false,timeat(-fk))
        f.sbar := bar_index - fk // [OTE]
        f.oteInit() // [OTEF]
        f.aplus := false // [DE] A+ off
        f.disp := deDispOK // [DE]
        lastshortfvg := f
        if not hasifp and hasfp and doifp and not fpLow
            fp = fpfvgs.last()
            if fp.islong != f.islong
                f.isifp := true
                hasifp := true
                fpfvgs.push(f)
        if not hasfp and isFPFVG() and not f.isifp
            f.isfp := true
            f.iswfp := dayofweek == dayofweek.monday
            hasfp := f.isfp
            fpfvgs.push(f)
            clearlastfp(fpfvgs)
        else if not fponly and not f.isifp and (not deDisp or deDispOK)
            fs.route(f)
        else 
            f.kill()

// 1PFVG from the 1m candles: the 1m candles of this chart bar, in order, each one tested as candle [0] of
// isFPFVG on the 1m chart (candles [1] to [3] are the three before it)
[l1t, l1o, l1h, l1l, l1c] = request.security_lower_tf(syminfo.tickerid, fpLowTf ? "1" : timeframe.period,
     [time, open, high, low, close])
var array<float> fpO = array.new<float>()
var array<float> fpH = array.new<float>()
var array<float> fpL = array.new<float>()
var array<float> fpC = array.new<float>()
var array<int> fpT = array.new<int>()
var int fpLastT = na
if fpLow and barstate.isconfirmed and not na(l1t) and l1t.size() > 0
    for j = 0 to l1t.size() - 1
        int t0 = l1t.get(j)
        if na(fpLastT) or t0 > fpLastT
            fpLastT := t0
            fpO.push(l1o.get(j))
            fpH.push(l1h.get(j))
            fpL.push(l1l.get(j))
            fpC.push(l1c.get(j))
            fpT.push(t0)
            if fpT.size() > 4
                fpO.shift()
                fpH.shift()
                fpL.shift()
                fpC.shift()
                fpT.shift()
            bool fpWin = not hasfp and minute(t0, tz) > fpm + 2
            bool ifpWin = hasfp and doifp and not hasifp and fpfvgs.size() > 0
            if fpT.size() == 4 and hour(t0, tz) == fph and (fpWin or ifpWin)
                // index 2: candle [1], 1: [2], 0: [3]
                [lhi, llo, lfhi, lflo] = longFVGHL(fpO.get(2), fpC.get(2), fpL.get(2), fpO.get(1),
                     fpC.get(1), fpO.get(0), fpC.get(0), fpH.get(0))
                [shi, slo, sfhi, sflo] = shortFVGHL(fpO.get(2), fpC.get(2), fpH.get(2), fpO.get(1),
                     fpC.get(1), fpO.get(0), fpC.get(0), fpL.get(0))
                bool isL = lfhi - lflo > minfvg and lfhi - lflo < maxfvg
                bool isS = sfhi - sflo > minfvg and sfhi - sflo < maxfvg
                if ifpWin
                    // inverse 1PFVG: the first 1m FVG of the opposite bias after the 1PFVG
                    bool fpLong = fpfvgs.last().islong
                    isL := isL and not fpLong
                    isS := isS and fpLong
                if isL or isS
                    FVG f = isL ? FVG.new(lhi, llo, math.avg(lhi, llo), true, fpT.get(0))
                         : FVG.new(shi, slo, math.avg(shi, slo), false, fpT.get(0))
                    f.sbar := bar_index
                    if ifpWin
                        f.isifp := true
                        hasifp := true
                        fpfvgs.push(f)
                    else
                        f.isfp := true
                        f.iswfp := dayofweek(t0, tz) == dayofweek.monday
                        hasfp := true
                        fpfvgs.push(f)
                        clearlastfp(fpfvgs)

updfvgs(array<FVG> fvgs) =>
    if fvgs.size() > 0
        for i = 0 to fvgs.size()-1
            f = fvgs.get(i)
            // [PERF] a finished FVG whose drawings already end at its end needs no more work (a merge resets
            // end, and a kill clears the drawings, so those are redone)
            if not na(f.end) and f.end == f.updEnd and (stySeg ? not na(f.hiln) : not na(f.rect))
                continue
            isdone = not na(f.end)
            // check if filled
            if not isdone and f.isDone(open,close)
                f.end := f.endsAt()
                // [REL] small FVG filled: hidden later unless it formed at a swing
                if f.relSmall() and not f.swp and not f.ext and not f.kept and not f.cand
                    f.dbar := bar_index
                    relS.push(f)
            // [OTEF] retraced into while matching the OTE band of its leg (FVG shown as a plain FVG)
            if not isdone and na(f.end) and na(f.dup) and f.oteFvgStep() and not na(f.rect) and not f.cand and not f.kept
                f.rect.set_text(fvgLbl(f))
                f.rect.set_text_size(ifvgtsz)
                f.rect.set_text_halign(ifvgha)
                f.rect.set_text_valign(ifvgva)
            et = f.endsAt()
            if stySeg
                if na(f.hiln)
                    f.hiln := line.new(f.start, f.hi, et, f.hi,
                        color = f.lnColor(),
                        xloc = xloc.bar_time,
                        extend = (f.isifp or f.isfp) ? extend.right : extend.none,
                        width = 1)
                    f.loln := line.new(f.start, f.lo, et, f.lo,
                        color = f.lnColor(),
                        xloc = xloc.bar_time,
                        extend = (f.isifp or f.isfp) ? extend.right : extend.none,
                        width = 1)
            else if na(f.rect)
                f.rect := box.new(f.start, f.hi, et, f.lo,
                    bgcolor = f.bgColor(),
                    border_color = f.lnColor(),
                    border_width = 1,
                    xloc = xloc.bar_time,
                    extend = (f.isifp or f.isfp) ? extend.right : extend.none,
                    border_style = line.style_solid)
                if fvgLbl(f) != ""
                    f.rect.set_text(fvgLbl(f))
                    f.rect.set_text_size(ifvgtsz)
                    f.rect.set_text_halign(ifvgha)
                    f.rect.set_text_valign(ifvgva)
            if na(f.celine) and f.hi-f.lo > mince
                f.celine := line.new(f.start,f.ce,et,f.ce,
                    color = f.lnColor(),
                    style = cesty,
                    xloc = xloc.bar_time,
                    width = celnwid)
                if f.isfp
                    f.celine.set_extend(extend.right)
            // always follow the end: an FVG extended by a merged duplicate (end reset) has to grow again.
            // [PERF] a live FVG is only stretched to the current bar on the last bar (and in real time): on
            // history nobody sees it, and moving every box on every bar was most of the run time
            if not na(f.end) or barstate.islast or barstate.isrealtime
                if not na(f.rect) and not f.kept
                    f.rect.set_right(et)
                if not na(f.hiln)
                    f.hiln.set_x2(et)
                    f.loln.set_x2(et)
                if not na(f.celine)
                    f.celine.set_x2(et)
                if not na(f.end)
                    f.updEnd := f.end
            if dofvgalert and na(f.end) and barstate.isconfirmed
                f.alerts()
        if fvgs.size() >= maxfvgs  and fvgs.size() > 0
            df = fvgs.shift()
            df.kill()

// FVG filter: liquidity sweeps ===================================
float fPH = ta.pivothigh(high, flL, flR)
float fPL = ta.pivotlow(low, flL, flR)
if not fltOff
    // sweeps are tested against the levels known BEFORE this bar
    if not na(fs.stH) and high > fs.stH
        onSweep(fs.stLbar)  // arm = from the last short-term low to the sweep
        fs.post := 0
        fs.stH := na
    if not na(fs.stL) and low < fs.stL
        onSweep(fs.stHbar)  // arm = from the last short-term high to the sweep
        fs.post := 0
        fs.stL := na
    if not na(fPH)
        fs.stH := fPH
        fs.stHbar := bar_index - flR
    if not na(fPL)
        fs.stL := fPL
        fs.stLbar := bar_index - flR

// [REL] "relevant" filter: live FVGs not shown yet ===============
float relAtr = ta.atr(atrLen)
// recent relevant: relF is in creation order, so the old ones are at its front
if fltRecent
    while relF.size() > 0 and bar_index - nz(relF.first().sbar, bar_index) > relMaxAge
        relF.shift()
if fltRel and barstate.isconfirmed and relF.size() > 0
    for i = relF.size() - 1 to 0
        FVG f = relF.get(i)
        if f.shown or not na(f.dup)
            relF.remove(i)
        else if f.isDone(open, close)
            // the last FVG before a sweep, closed through after it: an IFVG, shown up to the close
            if f.swp
                f.end := time
                reveal(f)
            relF.remove(i)
        else if f.oteFvgStep()
            // retraced into while matching the OTE band of its leg
            reveal(f)
            relF.remove(i)
if fltRel and barstate.islast
    // live FVGs near the price: redrawn on each update of the last bar
    while relB.size() > 0
        relB.pop().delete()
    float rng = nz(relAtr) * minATR
    for f in relF
        if not f.shown and na(f.dup) and na(f.end) and relB.size() < 40
            float dist = close > f.hi ? close - f.hi : close < f.lo ? f.lo - close : 0.0
            if dist <= rng
                relB.push(box.new(f.start, f.hi, time, f.lo, xloc = xloc.bar_time,
                     bgcolor = f.bgColor(), border_color = f.lnColor(), border_width = 1,
                     border_style = line.style_solid, text = fvgLbl(f), text_size = ifvgtsz,
                     text_halign = ifvgha, text_valign = ifvgva))

if not visible and barstate.isnew
    updfvgs(lfvgs)
    updfvgs(sfvgs)
    updfvgs(fpfvgs)
else if true
    if time < chart.right_visible_bar_time + (chart.right_visible_bar_time-chart.left_visible_bar_time)
        updfvgs(lfvgs)
        updfvgs(sfvgs)
        updfvgs(fpfvgs)

// [OTE] prior leg detection =====================================
// Pivot sets: one for the chart timeframe and one for each of the next two higher timeframes.
// HTF pivots come from request.security (non-repainting: confirmed HTF bars only) and are
// stored with the CHART bar index they map to, so legs can be measured on chart candles.

tfName(string s) =>
    float m = str.tonumber(s)
    string r = s
    if not na(m)
        r := m >= 60 and m % 60 == 0 ? str.tostring(m / 60, "#") + "h" : str.tostring(m, "#") + "m"
    else if s == "1D"
        r := "D"
    r

type PivSet
    array<int> hb       // pivot-high chart bar index
    array<float> hp     // pivot-high price
    array<int> lb       // pivot-low chart bar index
    array<float> lp     // pivot-low price
    string tag = ""     // timeframe label
    bool htf = false    // higher timeframe set?

method addHigh(PivSet ps, int b, float p) =>
    ps.hb.push(b)
    ps.hp.push(p)
    if ps.hb.size() > 60
        ps.hb.shift()
        ps.hp.shift()

method addLow(PivSet ps, int b, float p) =>
    ps.lb.push(b)
    ps.lp.push(p)
    if ps.lb.size() > 60
        ps.lb.shift()
        ps.lp.shift()

method lastHigh(PivSet ps) =>
    ps.hp.size() > 0 ? ps.hp.last() : na

method lastLow(PivSet ps) =>
    ps.lp.size() > 0 ? ps.lp.last() : na

var PivSet pv0 = PivSet.new(array.new<int>(), array.new<float>(), array.new<int>(), array.new<float>(), "", false)
var PivSet pv1 = PivSet.new(array.new<int>(), array.new<float>(), array.new<int>(), array.new<float>(), "", true)
var PivSet pv2 = PivSet.new(array.new<int>(), array.new<float>(), array.new<int>(), array.new<float>(), "", true)

// --- chart timeframe pivots
float oph = ta.pivothigh(high, pivL, pivR)
float opl = ta.pivotlow(low, pivL, pivR)
pv0.tag := tfName(timeframe.period)
if not na(oph)
    pv0.addHigh(bar_index - pivR, oph)
if not na(opl)
    pv0.addLow(bar_index - pivR, opl)

// [REL] small filled FVGs: once a pivot at its candles would be confirmed, hide it if there is none and it
// was not extended by a merged FVG (or became an IFVG box) meanwhile
hasPiv(array<int> bars, int b0, int b1) =>
    bool r = false
    int n = bars.size()
    if n > 0
        for k = n - 1 to 0
            int b = bars.get(k)
            if b < b0
                break
            if b <= b1
                r := true
                break
    r

relHide(FVG f) =>
    array<FVG> arr = f.islong ? lfvgs : sfvgs
    int n = arr.size()
    if n > 0
        for k = n - 1 to 0
            FVG g = arr.get(k)
            if g.start == f.start and g.hi == f.hi and g.lo == f.lo
                arr.remove(k)
                break
    f.shown := false
    f.kill()

if fltRel and relS.size() > 0
    for i = relS.size() - 1 to 0
        FVG f = relS.get(i)
        if bar_index >= math.max(f.dbar, f.sbar + 3 + pivR)
            relS.remove(i)
            bool keep = f.ext or f.kept or f.cand or not f.relSmall()
                 or hasPiv(pv0.hb, f.sbar - 1, f.sbar + 3) or hasPiv(pv0.lb, f.sbar - 1, f.sbar + 3)
            if not keep
                relHide(f)

// --- higher timeframe ladder: 3m(or lower) -> 5m -> 15m -> 1h -> 4h -> D
// The chart is placed on the highest rung that is <= the chart timeframe, and the next two rungs are used.
float tfmin = tfsecs / 60
var array<int> ladMin = array.from(3, 5, 15, 60, 240, 1440)
var array<string> ladTf = array.from("3", "5", "15", "60", "240", "D")
int ladIdx = 0
for i = 0 to 5
    if ladMin.get(i) <= tfmin
        ladIdx := i
string htf1 = ladIdx + 1 <= 5 ? ladTf.get(ladIdx + 1) : ""
string htf2 = ladIdx + 2 <= 5 ? ladTf.get(ladIdx + 2) : ""
bool hasH1 = oteHtf1 and htf1 != ""
bool hasH2 = oteHtf2 and htf2 != ""
pv1.tag := hasH1 ? tfName(htf1) : ""
pv2.tag := hasH2 ? tfName(htf2) : ""

string rq1 = hasH1 ? htf1 : timeframe.period
string rq2 = hasH2 ? htf2 : timeframe.period
[h1ph, h1pl, h1pt] = request.security(syminfo.tickerid, rq1,
    [ta.pivothigh(high, oteHtfL, oteHtfR)[1], ta.pivotlow(low, oteHtfL, oteHtfR)[1], time[oteHtfR + 1]],
    lookahead = barmerge.lookahead_on)
[h2ph, h2pl, h2pt] = request.security(syminfo.tickerid, rq2,
    [ta.pivothigh(high, oteHtfL, oteHtfR)[1], ta.pivotlow(low, oteHtfL, oteHtfR)[1], time[oteHtfR + 1]],
    lookahead = barmerge.lookahead_on)
h1chg = ta.change(h1pt)
h2chg = ta.change(h2pt)

// chart bar index of the chart candle that opens at (or right before) time t
barOfTime(int t) =>
    int r = na
    int mx = math.min(bar_index, 4900)
    for k = 0 to mx
        if time[k] <= t
            r := bar_index - k
            break
    r

// a new HTF pivot is registered once, on the first chart bar after its HTF bar closed
feedHtf(PivSet ps, float ph, float pl, int pt, bool evt) =>
    if evt and (not na(ph) or not na(pl))
        int b = barOfTime(pt)
        if not na(b)
            if not na(ph)
                ps.addHigh(b, ph)
            if not na(pl)
                ps.addLow(b, pl)

if doifvg and useOTE
    feedHtf(pv1, h1ph, h1pl, h1pt, hasH1 and not na(h1chg) and h1chg != 0)
    feedHtf(pv2, h2ph, h2pl, h2pt, hasH2 and not na(h2chg) and h2chg != 0)

// Returns [legHigh, legLow] of the leg that precedes the FVG starting at bar sbar.
//   dir = -1 (bearish IFVG, from a bullish FVG): prior DOWN leg = last pivot high before sbar -> lowest low up to sbar
//   dir = +1 (bullish IFVG, from a bearish FVG): prior UP leg   = last pivot low before sbar  -> highest high up to sbar
priorLeg(int dir, int sbar, PivSet ps) =>
    float h = na
    float l = na
    if dir == -1
        int n = ps.hb.size()
        if n > 0
            for i = n - 1 to 0
                int hb = ps.hb.get(i)
                if hb < sbar and bar_index - hb < 4000
                    float lo = low[bar_index - hb]
                    for k = hb to sbar
                        lo := math.min(lo, low[bar_index - k])
                    h := ps.hp.get(i)
                    l := lo
                    break
    else
        int n = ps.lb.size()
        if n > 0
            for i = n - 1 to 0
                int lb = ps.lb.get(i)
                if lb < sbar and bar_index - lb < 4000
                    float hi = high[bar_index - lb]
                    for k = lb to sbar
                        hi := math.max(hi, high[bar_index - k])
                    l := ps.lp.get(i)
                    h := hi
                    break
    [h, l]

// [OTE] tracker =================================================
// One tracker follows one IFVG under watch, against the pivots of ONE timeframe (chart, HTF1 or HTF2).
//   dir = -1 : bearish IFVG (bullish FVG closed through to the downside).
//   dir = +1 : bullish IFVG (bearish FVG closed through to the upside).
// Two OTE checks, both done per timeframe:
//   (1) rejection: the confirming candle wicks into the 0.62-0.79 band of the PRIOR leg (before the FVG)
//   (2) retrace  : after the inversion, price retraces into the IFVG while the IFVG matches the OTE band of
//                  the leg swing -> lowest low (bearish) / swing -> highest high (bullish) since confirmation.
//                  On higher timeframes the swing origin is the latest HTF pivot (if beyond the retrace extreme).
type OteTrack
    int dir = 0
    float zlo = na      // IFVG low
    float zhi = na      // IFVG high
    float legHi = na
    float legLo = na
    float rext = na     // running retrace extreme since the FVG (high for dir -1, low for dir +1)
    bool armed = false  // IFVG confirmed by a close through it
    bool fired = false  // OTE signal already fired for this confirmation
    int ctime = na      // confirmation time
    int cbar = na       // confirmation bar index
    box band = na       // OTE band drawn (leg created after the inversion)
    float pHi = na      // prior leg high (leg before the FVG)
    float pLo = na      // prior leg low
    int sbar = na       // bar index where the FVG starts
    bool rejHit = false // confirming candle rejected the OTE of the prior leg
    box rej = na        // prior-leg OTE band drawn
    string tag = ""     // timeframe label
    int col = 0         // margin column of its timeframe (chart, then each higher timeframe)

// first bar of the OTE bands of t: one column per timeframe, so the bands and labels of several
// timeframes do not overlap
oteX0(OteTrack t) =>
    bar_index + oteOffset + t.col * (oteWidth + 1)

// new IFVG candidate under watch (not yet confirmed). origin = retrace extreme since the FVG
method oteStart(OteTrack t, int dir, float zlo, float zhi, float origin, int sbar, PivSet ps) =>
    box.delete(t.band)
    t.band := na
    box.delete(t.rej)
    t.rej := na
    t.rejHit := false
    t.sbar := sbar
    t.tag := ps.tag
    [pgh, pgl] = priorLeg(dir, sbar, ps)
    t.pHi := pgh
    t.pLo := pgl
    float o = origin
    if ps.htf
        float adj = dir == -1 ? ps.lastHigh() : ps.lastLow()
        if not na(adj)
            o := dir == -1 ? math.max(origin, adj) : math.min(origin, adj)
    t.dir := dir
    t.zlo := zlo
    t.zhi := zhi
    t.armed := false
    t.fired := false
    t.ctime := na
    t.rext := origin
    t.legHi := dir == -1 ? o : na
    t.legLo := dir == 1 ? o : na

// close through the FVG: the IFVG is confirmed, the leg starts being measured
method oteConfirm(OteTrack t) =>
    if t.dir != 0 and not t.armed
        // rejection of the OTE of the PRIOR leg by the confirming candle
        if useOTE and oteRej and not na(t.pHi) and not na(t.pLo) and t.pHi > t.pLo
            float pr = t.pHi - t.pLo
            float ext = na
            float rLo = na
            float rHi = na
            bool hit = false
            if t.dir == -1
                // prior down leg: OTE band is above the leg low; wick must reach up into it
                ext := oteRejAny ? math.max(t.rext, high) : high
                rLo := t.pLo + oteMin * pr
                rHi := t.pLo + oteMax * pr
                hit := ext >= rLo and ext <= (oteRejCap ? rHi : t.pHi) and close <= rHi
            else
                // prior up leg: OTE band is below the leg high; wick must reach down into it
                ext := oteRejAny ? math.min(t.rext, low) : low
                rLo := t.pHi - oteMax * pr
                rHi := t.pHi - oteMin * pr
                hit := ext <= rHi and ext >= (oteRejCap ? rLo : t.pLo) and close >= rLo
            if hit
                t.rejHit := true
                if showOTEband
                    t.rej := box.new(oteX0(t), rHi, oteX0(t) + oteWidth, rLo,
                        xloc = xloc.bar_index,
                        bgcolor = oteBandCol,
                        border_color = oteHighlight,
                        border_style = line.style_dashed,
                        border_width = 1,
                        text = t.tag + " OTE" + (t.dir == 1 ? " ↑" : " ↓"),
                        text_size = size.small,
                        text_color = oteTextCol,
                        text_halign = text.align_center)
        t.armed := true
        t.fired := t.rejHit // one OTE signal per IFVG
        t.ctime := time
        t.cbar := bar_index
        if t.dir == -1
            t.legHi := math.max(t.legHi, high)
            t.legLo := low
        else
            t.legLo := math.min(t.legLo, low)
            t.legHi := high

// IFVG invalidated (closed back through it)
method oteCancel(OteTrack t) =>
    box.delete(t.band)
    t.band := na
    box.delete(t.rej)
    t.rej := na
    t.rejHit := false
    t.armed := false
    if t.dir == -1
        t.legLo := na
    else
        t.legHi := na

// call once per bar. Returns the direction (-1 / 1) on the bar the OTE is matched, else 0
method oteStep(OteTrack t) =>
    int s = 0
    if useOTE and t.dir != 0
        if not t.armed
            // before confirmation keep extending the origin of the leg
            if t.dir == -1
                t.legHi := math.max(t.legHi, high)
                t.rext := math.max(t.rext, high)
            else
                t.legLo := math.min(t.legLo, low)
                t.rext := math.min(t.rext, low)
        else
            if not na(t.rej)
                t.rej.set_left(oteX0(t))
                t.rej.set_right(oteX0(t) + oteWidth)
            // rejection of the prior-leg OTE flagged on the confirming candle
            if t.rejHit
                s := t.dir
                t.rejHit := false
            float r = t.legHi - t.legLo
            if r > 0
                float bLo = na
                float bHi = na
                if t.dir == -1
                    bLo := t.legLo + oteMin * r
                    bHi := t.legLo + oteMax * r
                else
                    bLo := t.legHi - oteMax * r
                    bHi := t.legHi - oteMin * r
                float mid = math.avg(t.zlo, t.zhi)
                bool m = false
                if oteMode == "Overlap"
                    m := t.zhi >= bLo and t.zlo <= bHi
                else if oteMode == "Fully inside"
                    m := t.zlo >= bLo and t.zhi <= bHi
                else
                    m := mid >= bLo and mid <= bHi
                if showOTEband
                    color bg = m ? oteBandCol : color.new(color.gray, 92)
                    color bd = m ? oteHighlight : color.new(color.gray, 60)
                    if na(t.band)
                        t.band := box.new(oteX0(t), bHi, oteX0(t) + oteWidth, bLo,
                            xloc = xloc.bar_index,
                            bgcolor = bg,
                            border_color = bd,
                            border_style = line.style_dashed,
                            border_width = 1,
                            text = t.tag + (t.dir == 1 ? " ↑" : " ↓"),
                            text_size = size.tiny,
                            text_color = oteTextCol,
                            text_halign = text.align_left)
                    else
                        t.band.set_top(bHi)
                        t.band.set_bottom(bLo)
                        t.band.set_left(oteX0(t))
                        t.band.set_right(oteX0(t) + oteWidth)
                        t.band.set_bgcolor(bg)
                        t.band.set_border_color(bd)
                        t.band.set_text(t.tag + (t.dir == 1 ? " ↑" : " ↓"))
                // price retraces back into the IFVG while it matches the OTE band
                bool tap = t.dir == -1 ? high >= t.zlo : low <= t.zhi
                if m and tap and not t.fired and time != t.ctime and barstate.isconfirmed
                    t.fired := true
                    s := t.dir
            // keep extending the leg AFTER evaluating this bar
            if t.dir == -1
                t.legLo := math.min(t.legLo, low)
            else
                t.legHi := math.max(t.legHi, high)
    s

// A group runs the three trackers (chart, next TF, second TF) on the same IFVG.
// A confirmed OTE on ANY of them is enough to flag the IFVG as an OTE IFVG (once per IFVG).
type OteGroup
    OteTrack t0
    OteTrack t1
    OteTrack t2
    bool flagged = false
    string tags = ""    // timeframes that matched, e.g. "5m+15m"

method gStart(OteGroup g, int dir, float zlo, float zhi, float origin, int sbar) =>
    g.flagged := false
    g.tags := ""
    g.t0.col := 0
    g.t1.col := 1
    g.t2.col := hasH1 ? 2 : 1
    g.t0.oteStart(dir, zlo, zhi, origin, sbar, pv0)
    if hasH1
        g.t1.oteStart(dir, zlo, zhi, origin, sbar, pv1)
    if hasH2
        g.t2.oteStart(dir, zlo, zhi, origin, sbar, pv2)

method gConfirm(OteGroup g) =>
    g.t0.oteConfirm()
    g.t1.oteConfirm()
    g.t2.oteConfirm()

method gCancel(OteGroup g) =>
    g.flagged := false
    g.tags := ""
    g.t0.oteCancel()
    g.t1.oteCancel()
    g.t2.oteCancel()

method gStep(OteGroup g) =>
    int s0 = g.t0.oteStep()
    int s1 = g.t1.oteStep()
    int s2 = g.t2.oteStep()
    int s = 0
    if not g.flagged and (s0 != 0 or s1 != 0 or s2 != 0)
        g.flagged := true
        s := s0 != 0 ? s0 : (s1 != 0 ? s1 : s2)
        string tg = ""
        if s0 != 0
            tg += g.t0.tag
        if s1 != 0
            tg += (tg == "" ? "" : "+") + g.t1.tag
        if s2 != 0
            tg += (tg == "" ? "" : "+") + g.t2.tag
        g.tags := tg
    s

var OteGroup gBear = OteGroup.new(OteTrack.new(), OteTrack.new(), OteTrack.new())  // non-swing mode, bearish IFVG (from last long FVG)
var OteGroup gBull = OteGroup.new(OteTrack.new(), OteTrack.new(), OteTrack.new())  // non-swing mode, bullish IFVG (from last short FVG)
var OteGroup gSw   = OteGroup.new(OteTrack.new(), OteTrack.new(), OteTrack.new())  // swing mode, single IFVG under watch

// highest/lowest of the 4 bars spanning the FVG (3 candles + current bar)
h4 = ta.highest(high, 4)
l4 = ta.lowest(low, 4)

// Close above/below IFVG setups =================================

var box ifvgBox = na // IFVG used when using swings or bullifvg (bear fvg) when not using swings
var box ifvgBoxb = na // when not using swings, bearifvg
var FVG bullifvg = na
var FVG bearifvg = na
var int bullconfirm = na
var int bearconfirm = na
var int bullInv = 0       // [DE] inversions of the bull candidate (-1 invalidated)
var int bearInv = 0
var bool bullAp = false   // [DE] A+ IFVG
var bool bearAp = false
if doifvg and not ifvgswings and not na(lastlongfvg)
    if not na(bearifvg)
        bearifvg.release(not na(bearconfirm), bearconfirm)
    bearifvg := lastlongfvg
    bearconfirm := na
    bearInv := 0
    bearAp := false
    gBear.gStart(-1, bearifvg.lo, bearifvg.hi, h4, bearifvg.sbar) // [OTE]
    ifvgBoxb := bearifvg.adopt(-1)
if doifvg and not ifvgswings and not na(lastshortfvg)
    if not na(bullifvg)
        bullifvg.release(not na(bullconfirm), bullconfirm)
    bullifvg := lastshortfvg
    bullconfirm := na
    bullInv := 0
    bullAp := false
    gBull.gStart(1, bullifvg.lo, bullifvg.hi, l4, bullifvg.sbar) // [OTE]
    ifvgBox := bullifvg.adopt(1)
if not na(ifvgBox) and barstate.isnew
    ifvgBox.set_right(time)
if not na(ifvgBoxb) and barstate.isnew
    ifvgBoxb.set_right(time)

// Possible IFVGs for IFVG setups

// IFVG signals
sig = 0
// 1PFVG (or inverse 1PFVG) zone, or a duplicate merged into one: it keeps its own look
isFp(FVG fv) =>
    FVG f = na(fv) ? na : (na(fv.dup) ? fv : fv.dup)
    not na(f) and (f.isfp or f.isifp)

// [DE] invalidated IFVG: faded (stays as it is, no longer extended) or back to the plain FVG
deKill(FVG fv) =>
    FVG f = na(fv.dup) ? fv : fv.dup
    // a 1PFVG always goes back to its own look
    if deDead == "Back to FVG" or f.isfp or f.isifp
        f.restore()
    else
        f.kept := false
        f.cand := false
        if not na(f.rect)
            f.rect.set_bgcolor(deDeadCol)
            f.rect.set_border_color(deDeadCol)
            f.rect.set_border_width(1)
            f.rect.set_text("")
            f.rect.set_right(time)
    true

// [DE] the box of an inverted zone in direction d
deRecolor(box b, int d, FVG fv) =>
    if not na(b) and not isFp(fv)
        color c = d < 0 ? bearIFVGColor : bullIFVGColor
        b.set_bgcolor(color.new(c, ifvgTrans))
        b.set_border_color(color.new(c, borderTrans))
    true

if doifvg and not ifvgswings and not deInv
    if not na(bullifvg) and not na(bullconfirm) and barstate.isconfirmed and close < bullifvg.lo
        bullconfirm := na
        gBull.gCancel() // [OTE]
        ifvgBox.set_text(na)
    if not na(bullifvg) and barstate.isconfirmed and upBreak(bullifvg.hi) and na(bullconfirm)
        bullconfirm := time
        gBull.gConfirm() // [OTE]
        bullAp := false
        ifvgBox.set_text(ifvgTxt(1, 1, false, "", bullAp, mbOf(bullifvg)))
        sig := 1
    if not na(bearifvg) and not na(bearconfirm) and barstate.isconfirmed and close > bearifvg.hi
        bearconfirm := na
        gBear.gCancel() // [OTE]
        ifvgBoxb.set_text(na)
    if not na(bearifvg) and barstate.isconfirmed and dnBreak(bearifvg.lo) and na(bearconfirm)
        bearAp := false
        ifvgBoxb.set_text(ifvgTxt(-1, 1, false, "", bearAp, mbOf(bearifvg)))
        bearconfirm := time
        gBear.gConfirm() // [OTE]
        sig := -1

// [DE] inversion rules: every close through the zone inverts it again, up to the max; then it is invalidated.
// Bull candidate (bearish FVG): inversions 1, 3, ... are bullish (close above), 2, 4, ... bearish (close below).
if doifvg and not ifvgswings and deInv and barstate.isconfirmed
    if not na(bullifvg) and bullInv >= 0
        bool brk = bullInv % 2 == 0 ? upBreak(bullifvg.hi) : dnBreak(bullifvg.lo)
        if brk
            if bullInv >= deMaxInv
                bullInv := -1
                bullconfirm := na
                gBull.gCancel() // [OTE]
                deKill(bullifvg)
                ifvgBox := na
            else
                bullInv += 1
                int d = bullInv % 2 == 1 ? 1 : -1
                if bullInv == 1
                    bullconfirm := time
                    gBull.gConfirm() // [OTE]
                else
                    bullconfirm := na
                    gBull.gCancel() // [OTE] only the first inversion
                    deRecolor(ifvgBox, d, bullifvg)
                bullAp := false
                ifvgBox.set_text(ifvgTxt(d, bullInv, false, "", bullAp, mbOf(bullifvg)))
                sig := d
    if not na(bearifvg) and bearInv >= 0
        bool brk = bearInv % 2 == 0 ? dnBreak(bearifvg.lo) : upBreak(bearifvg.hi)
        if brk
            if bearInv >= deMaxInv
                bearInv := -1
                bearconfirm := na
                gBear.gCancel() // [OTE]
                deKill(bearifvg)
                ifvgBoxb := na
            else
                bearInv += 1
                int d = bearInv % 2 == 1 ? -1 : 1
                if bearInv == 1
                    bearconfirm := time
                    gBear.gConfirm() // [OTE]
                else
                    bearconfirm := na
                    gBear.gCancel() // [OTE] only the first inversion
                    deRecolor(ifvgBoxb, d, bearifvg)
                bearAp := false
                ifvgBoxb.set_text(ifvgTxt(d, bearInv, false, "", bearAp, mbOf(bearifvg)))
                sig := sig == 0 ? d : sig

updKept()

// [OTE] signals: IFVG retraced into and matches the OTE band =================
int bearOteSig = gBear.gStep()
int bullOteSig = gBull.gStep()
int swOteSig = gSw.gStep()

int oteSig = 0
if bearOteSig != 0
    oteSig := -1
else if bullOteSig != 0
    oteSig := 1
else if swOteSig != 0
    oteSig := swOteSig

if doifvg and useOTE
    if bearOteSig != 0 and not na(ifvgBoxb)
        ifvgBoxb.set_text(ifvgTxt(-1, 1, true, gBear.tags, bearAp, mbOf(bearifvg)))
        if not isFp(bearifvg)
            ifvgBoxb.set_border_color(oteHighlight)
    if bullOteSig != 0 and not na(ifvgBox)
        ifvgBox.set_text(ifvgTxt(1, 1, true, gBull.tags, bullAp, mbOf(bullifvg)))
        if not isFp(bullifvg)
            ifvgBox.set_border_color(oteHighlight)

plotshape(showSignals and not hideReg and sig == -1 and sig[1] == 0, 
    title = "SHORT", style = shape.triangledown, 
        location = location.abovebar, color = bearIFVGColor, size = size.small, text = "SHORT")

plotshape(showSignals and not hideReg and sig == 1 and sig[1] == 0, 
    title = "LONG", style = shape.triangleup, 
        location = location.belowbar, color = bullIFVGColor, size = size.small, text = "LONG")

plotshape(showOTEsig and not hideReg and oteSig == -1, 
    title = "SHORT OTE", style = shape.diamond, 
        location = location.abovebar, color = oteHighlight, size = size.small, text = "OTE")

plotshape(showOTEsig and not hideReg and oteSig == 1, 
    title = "LONG OTE", style = shape.diamond, 
        location = location.belowbar, color = oteHighlight, size = size.small, text = "OTE")

//──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// ALERTS
//──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
tfstr() =>
    string tf = timeframe.period
    if timeframe.isseconds
        str.replace(tf, "S", "s")
    else if timeframe.isminutes
        if tf == "60"
            "1h"
        else if tf == "120"
            "2h"
        else if tf == "180"
            "3h"
        else if tf == "240"
            "4h"
        else
            tf + "m"
    else if timeframe.isdaily
        // If it's exactly 1 day ("1D"), UI just shows "D"
        tf == "1D" ? "D" : str.replace(tf, "D", "D") 
    else if timeframe.isweekly
        tf == "1W" ? "W" : str.replace(tf, "W", "W")
    else if timeframe.ismonthly
        tf == "1M" ? "M" : str.replace(tf, "M", "M")
    else
        tf


if doifvgalert and sig != 0 and not (useOTE and oteOnly) // [OTE] plain IFVG alerts can be suppressed
    if sig > 0
        alert("LONG IFVG "+tfstr(), alert.freq_once_per_bar)
    else
        alert("SHORT IFVG "+tfstr(), alert.freq_once_per_bar)

// [OTE] alerts
if doifvgalert and useOTE and oteSig != 0
    if oteSig > 0
        alert("LONG IFVG+OTE "+tfstr(), alert.freq_once_per_bar)
    else
        alert("SHORT IFVG+OTE "+tfstr(), alert.freq_once_per_bar)
